features.name: Oath Spells & Tenets
features.description:
**Oath of Safeguarding Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | longstrider, shield of faith |
| 5th | hold person, spike growth |
| 9th | beacon of hope, spirit guardians |
| 13th | dimension door, stoneskin |
| 17th | greater restoration, wall of stone |

**Tenets:** Last Line of Defense — remain when allies must retreat. Protect the Charge — preserve those you're sworn to guard. Shield All Innocents — defend the helpless in the absence of a sacred charge. Uphold the Vow — terminate guardianship only when the charge proves nefarious. Unwavering — nothing shall distract you from your mission.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain two Channel Divinity options:

**Insurmountable Passage.** As an action, stamp one foot: the ground within 60 ft becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. You can designate up to 10 creatures to ignore it.

**Protect from Harm.** As an action, speak reassuring words. For 1 minute, friendly creatures within 30 ft that can see/hear you have advantage on saving throws against damaging spells and abilities. Hostile creatures within 30 ft that can hear you must make a WIS save or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of their next turn.

features.name: Aura of Preservation
features.description:
Beginning at 7th level, you emit a 10-ft aura while not incapacitated. The first time you or a friendly creature within the aura would take damage from a weapon attack each round, it has resistance to nonmagical B/P/S damage. Friendly creatures within the aura have advantage on death saving throws.

At 18th level: range increases to 30 ft, and friendly creatures within 10 ft have resistance to all B/P/S damage.

features.name: Battlefield Controller
features.description: Starting at 15th level, you can't be shoved. When a hostile creature within 10 ft of you moves more than 10 ft away, you can use your reaction to move up to 10 ft and make an attack against it.

payload.name: Battlefield Controller
payload.description: When a hostile creature within 10 ft moves more than 10 ft away: move up to 10 ft and make an attack against it.

features.name: Redoubtable Defender
features.description:
At 20th level, as an action, touch a charge (creature or structure) to create a silver tether for 1 hour:

* Know your charge's general status and well-being.
* Teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 ft of the charge (or anywhere inside if it's a structure) as an action.
* Immune to charm effects that would make you harm your charge.
* If a creature charge is within 5 ft: it's immune to nonmagical B/P/S damage and has advantage on all saving throws.
* As an action, erect a *wall of force*-like barrier (hemispherical dome, sphere up to 5-ft radius, or four 10×10 panels) for 1 minute.

1/long rest.

payload.name: Redoubtable Defender
payload.description: Create silver tether to a charge for 1 hour: know its status, teleport to it, immune to charm vs charge, protect it from B/P/S, erect a force barrier (action).
